ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 no-show cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher; flag the driver's account for review of "I'm Here" misuse (tapped 600 m from pickup, never within 200 m).
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: chat [F8]–[F11] and the driver statement [F12] contain no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation; the dispute type is no-show, not safety. safety_concern = none.

NS-0 routing: the ride is RydeX, cancelled_by = driver with the driver asserting rider no-show [F3][F12], so NS-1/NS-2 apply. The $6.61 charged is the statutory cancellation fee [F3][F6].

NS-1 (i) is nominally met — the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 12:06:15 [F5]. But (ii) fails: at the moment of the tap the GPS put the driver 600 m from the pickup point, far outside the 200 m arrival radius [F5]; the driver's closest approach over the whole episode was 599 m and he never came within 200 m [F1], and the platform never recorded an arrival at the pickup [F4]. (iii) also fails: after the tap the driver spent 0 s within 200 m of the pickup [F5] — his 3 min 30 s stationary period at 600 m [F2] was not waiting at the pickup point, so it does not count toward the >3 minutes required.

NS-2 therefore applies to the driver's no-show cancellation: the $6.61 must be refunded in full, refund_full = $6.61. The independent GPS/timeline records [F1][F2][F4][F5] override the driver's written claim that he "waited more than 3 minutes at the pickup" [F12], and the rider's on-record message that no car was at the pickup point [F9] is consistent with the GPS. Because the driver pressed "I'm Here" while GPS showed him outside the pickup radius, NS-2 additionally calls for flag_account (misuse of the arrival/cancellation button), which is applied.

The driver's no-show justification is rejected; the rider's $6.61 charge is not supported. Weather fair [F15] and no traffic incidents [F14]; the JALAN BESAR speed band 3 [F13] is not band 1/2 congestion and is irrelevant to a no-show. Rider 30-day dispute window is not at issue. Profile facts [F16][F17] are not used to decide the case; the driver's prior upheld no-show [F17] already supports the account flag.

Evidence is sufficient: the timeline covers "I'm Here" through cancellation, GPS covers the waiting period without a gap, and all three chat messages are timestamped [F11].

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's post-trip statement that he waited >3 minutes at the pickup is contradicted by system records: he tapped "I'm Here" 600 m away [F5], his closest approach was 599 m [F1], he never came within 200 m, and the platform never recorded an arrival [F4]. NS-1 (ii) and (iii) both fail.
JALAN BESAR speed band 3 (20–29 km/h) is not band 1/2 congestion and does not excuse a no-show cancellation; no traffic incident was recorded [F14]. RD-4 is inapplicable to a no-show case.
